# WORK FLOW

- Import PRISMA review counts
- Convert to `PRISMA2020` data
- Draw PRISMA 2020 flow diagram
- Export PNG and PDF versions

# DATA

PRISMA input table: `{r} if (!is.null(in1) && nzchar(in1)) fs::path_rel(in1) else "PRISMA2020 package template"`

Output directory: `{r} fs::path_rel(dir_out)`



# Import

```{r}
# ============================================== #
# PRISMA data

prisma_raw <- readr::read_csv(
    here("data", in1),
    show_col_types = FALSE
  )

prisma_raw
```

# Edit data

```{r}
# ============================================== #
# convert the input table to the format required
# by PRISMA2020

prisma_data <- PRISMA2020::PRISMA_data(prisma_raw)
```

# Visualize

```{r}
#| label: prisma-flow-diagram
#| echo: true

# ============================================== #
# PRISMA 2020 flow diagram

# This review is treated as a new review:
# previous = FALSE removes the previous-review arm.
# other = FALSE keeps only identification via databases/registers.
# Change these arguments if other search routes were used.

prisma_plot <- PRISMA2020::PRISMA_flowdiagram(
  data = prisma_data,
  detail_databases = TRUE,
  interactive = FALSE,
  previous = FALSE,
  other = TRUE,
  side_boxes = TRUE,
  fontsize = 12
)

prisma_plot
```

# Export

```{r}
# ============================================== #
# export static versions

# Export settings
dpi <- 200
width_in <- 12
height_in <- 8

width_px <- width_in * dpi
height_px <- height_in * dpi


# ============================================== #
# PNG

PRISMA2020::PRISMA_save(
  plotobj = prisma_plot,
  filename = file.path(
    dir_out,
    "prisma_diagram.png"
  ),
  overwrite = TRUE,
  width = width_px,
  height = height_px
)


# ============================================== #
# PDF

PRISMA2020::PRISMA_save(
  plotobj = prisma_plot,
  filename = file.path(
    dir_out,
    "prisma_diagram.pdf"
  ),
  overwrite = TRUE
)

```





# Session info

```{r}
#| label: session-info

sessioninfo::session_info()
```

```{r}
#| label: run-info
#| echo: false

time_end <- Sys.time()
elapsed_sec <- as.numeric(difftime(time_end, time_start, units = "secs"))
elapsed_min <- as.numeric(difftime(time_end, time_start, units = "mins"))

readr::write_lines(
  c(
    paste("rendered_at:", Sys.time()),
    paste("input_file:", in1),
    paste("input_file:", in2),
    paste("output_dir:", dir_out),
    paste("run_time_seconds:", round(elapsed_sec, 1)),
    paste("run_time_minutes:", round(elapsed_min, 2))),
  file.path(dir_out, "run_info.txt")
)
```
